name: polyemesis-web

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/check-build.mjs

//overrides: sharp is pinned up for miniflare, not for us. wrangler -> miniflare pins sharp 0.35.2, which carries the libheif advisories GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 and GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545. It is a devDependency and never reaches the built site, but osv-scanner reads the whole lockfile and is right to: a dev toolchain is still a supply chain. Dependabot cannot deliver this -- wrangler 4.129.0 (#761) still resolves miniflare's own pin. The override does not add a second copy: miniflare deduplicates onto the top-level sharp 0.35.4 that astro already uses in this tree, so the vulnerable copy disappears rather than being shadowed. Remove this once miniflare ships 0.35.4 or later.
